basedOn: Qodo repository-root review configuration (.pr_agent.toml), adapted for the factory local reviewer
challenge: Day 11: make the reviewer yours (email from Filip Hric at Qodo, 16 Nov 2026 19:04 WIB)

productDecisions.decision: The F1 telemetry demo is a static dashboard opened from disk (file://) and must work fully offline.
productDecisions.reviewMust: Flag any network access in demo code as a blocker and suggest loading from local data instead. A relative fetch of local data is not a network violation — but fetch() is blocked when the demo is opened from file://, so say that and suggest inlining the data into the JS file or index.html.
productDecisions.reviewMustNot: Do not flag a relative fetch of local data as a network violation.

productDecisions.decision: The factory and the demo have zero runtime dependencies.
productDecisions.reviewMust: Flag any new dependency or package install as a blocker unless the ticket notes it.
productDecisions.reviewMustNot: Do not suggest adding a library as a fix.

productDecisions.decision: console.log in the factory CLI layer is intentional operator logging.
productDecisions.reviewMust: Treat console.log under src/factory as allowed and say so explicitly.
productDecisions.reviewMustNot: Do not flag factory CLI logging as noise.

productDecisions.decision: The demo dashboard output must stay clean for the end user.
productDecisions.reviewMust: Warn on console.log in demo code.

notes: Day 11 challenge: pick a real review that missed context, customize the setup, rerun on the same PR and compare. The original (default-profile) review and the customized review of the same sample change are recorded in evidence/runs/day-11-review-comparison.json (local stand-in). The REAL Qodo before/after comparison on PR #1 is recorded in evidence/runs/day-11-real-comparison.json: default 3 findings → custom 4 findings (+1 demo console.log, nothing lost). Decision: KEEP the custom setup, with rule 1 adjusted — a relative local fetch is not a network violation, but fetch() from file:// is still a real limitation; say so and suggest inlining. The setup is durable in the repo as .pr_agent.toml (PR-Agent reads repo config from the default branch) and stays the factory default review profile.
